# The Korea Times

> > The Korea Times is South Korea's leading English-language newspaper covering news, culture, and community events including the annual Korean Language Speaking Contest for foreigners.

The Korea Times serves as a bridge between Korea and the international community, providing English-language journalism and organizing cultural initiatives. The Korean Language Speaking Contest, held annually via YouTube, promotes Korean language learning among foreign nationals with awards from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.

## Key Topics

- The Korea Times
- Korean Language Speaking Contest
- Korean language learning

## Korean Language Speaking Contest 2025

- [2025 Korean Language Speaking Contest](https://klsc.koreatimes.co.kr/KoreanSpeakingContest_2025eng.html): Official English page for the 2025 Korean Language Speaking Contest for foreigners via YouTube, featuring competition details, submission guidelines, and award information
- [2025 외국인 한국어 말하기 대회](https://klsc.koreatimes.co.kr/KoreanSpeakingContest_2025kor.html): Korean-language version of the 2025 Korean Speaking Contest page for foreign participants, providing contest information in Korean
